name: deepresearch-bench-reference-raw
description: A raw reference collection intended as a benchmarking source for research tasks; it appears to aggregate problem instances or references for evaluating models across research-oriented tasks. evaluation_method: composite_score (mix of accuracy, exact_match, BLEU, or task-specific metrics as appropriate)
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face used experimentally by a limited set of researchers.
